verdict.rationale: Paystack documents that it collects one-time payments from an app or website through its API and Dashboard, with test and live keys separating development from production. Nothing in the evidence covers how fast a new account can go live, and card payments are never named explicitly. missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-live activation time (same-day onboarding, KYC/approval duration), explicit card-payment acceptance documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Collect one-time and recurring payments from your app or website
The Paystack API lets you programmatically collect payments, manage transactions, and perform other operations that you can also do from your Paystack Dashboard.
Use your test keys for development and testing, and your live keys for production.
